product_overview: Swift Stock is an iOS app that lets users enter a stock ticker symbol, fetch real-time market summary data, and view a 1-day intra-day price chart. The app focuses on a simple search-to-detail flow with lightweight UI styling and basic error handling.
core_goals: Allow users to search for a stock ticker and view its current market summary
Display a 1-day intra-day chart for the selected stock symbol
Validate ticker input and provide basic feedback for invalid symbols or missing data
Present a styled, easy-to-use mobile interface for stock lookup and chart viewing

features.name: Ticker Search and Stock Detail View
features.description: Users can enter a stock ticker symbol on the home screen and open a detail screen that loads the stock’s summary information.
user_flows: GET /login to open the search/home page -> Enter a valid ticker symbol such as AAPL -> GET /inventory is not used in this flow; transition to the DetailVC screen with the ticker parameter -> Receive stock detail screen
GET /login to open the search/home page -> Enter an empty ticker field -> No detail screen is opened and the user remains on the home page
GET /login to open the search/home page -> Enter invalid characters such as 123 -> Input is rejected by the field validation and the symbol is not submitted

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Users can view and manage product inventory records, including products, variants, and categories, in the frontend application.
user_flows: GET /inventory with a valid authenticated session -> Receive the inventory page and load the user’s product records
GET /inventory without an authenticated session -> Receive an authorization error or redirected access denial state

features.name: Database Synchronization
features.description: Users can back up and restore local Dexie data to and from a remote Supabase instance to keep data synchronized.
user_flows: GET /backup-restore with a valid authenticated session -> Receive backup and restore interface or sync status -> Local Dexie data is synchronized to Supabase
GET /backup-restore without authentication -> Receive an authorization error and sync does not start

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users authenticate to access protected areas of the app and maintain a session for authorized actions.
user_flows: GET /login to open the login page -> Submit valid credentials through the authentication flow -> Receive an authenticated session and access to protected pages
GET /login to open the login page -> Submit invalid or incomplete credentials -> Receive a login error and remain on the login screen
